why: Inbox, mail and messages are "Partly" buildable and were left out of the reference pages (benchmark section 11). What exists: `SplitPage` (basalt-ui/page, src/page/parts/split-page.tsx: a list column and a detail, one pane by `selected` on narrow, no resize), `Resizable` (basalt-ui/ui/resizable: `ResizablePanelGroup`, `ResizablePanel`, `ResizableHandle`; it persists nothing, the app passes `defaultLayout`), `RowList` (basalt-ui/cards, a verdict dot, no avatar or checkbox), `Avatar` and `AvatarStack` (basalt-ui/ui/avatar), `EntityChip` (basalt-ui/ui/entity), `VirtualList`, the record surface `Peek` with presentations peek, window and page (src/page/peek.tsx, src/page/core/panel-store.ts), `BulkBar` (basalt-ui/table, it reads the table's selection only). The composer comes from bench-chat-parts, the period buckets from bench-record-parts.
what: A mail row, day groups over a list, a remembered split, a message thread and a composer that opens as panel, window or page.
owns: new modules under packages/basalt-ui/src/cards for the mail row, the grouped list and the thread
packages/basalt-ui/src/table/parts/bulk-bar.tsx only to give it a list-neutral form
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md, sections 2 and 11. Decided: (1) `SplitPage` gains a resizable split: pointer and keyboard separator with a value, double-click resets, a minimum and maximum width, the width remembered per page through `persisted` (root export basalt-ui). Narrow keeps one pane at a time. (2) A mail row: avatar (a corner badge for the organisation where given), sender, subject, snippet, time, an unread dot with heavier sender text, a star, an entity chip, and hover and focus actions; the avatar swaps to a checkbox on hover, on focus and whenever any row is selected. Rows virtualise through `VirtualList`. (3) Day groups as sticky headers (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Earlier this month, then months), using the period bucketing bench-record-parts shipped beside `EventList`, not a second copy. (4) A thread: collapsed message rows that expand one at a time, the latest open, attachments as file cards, inline reply at the bottom. (5) The composer is bench-chat-parts' `Composer` with mail fields (to, cc, subject); it opens inline, as a panel, as a window or as the page, through the record surface with a compose kind, so the presentation persists like a record's and the draft is kept with `useFormDraft` (basalt-ui/controls). (6) Selection shows a bulk bar: `BulkBar` gains a form that takes a count and typed actions without a table; it must not clip inside a narrow list. (7) Phone: list, then reader as its own pane, composer as a bottom sheet. The proof page sits on the parts-inventory domain of the reference pages (apps/playground/src/routes/ref/, its fixtures and fixed today) and compiles on the playground's app lint preset with zero basalt waivers; if packages/basalt-ui/blocks/ exists when you start (bench-blocks landed), ship the page as a block instead of a route. The domain's mail is supplier correspondence about purchase orders.

A row shows the checkbox on hover, on focus and while any row is selected; selection shows the bulk bar, which stays inside the list (layout test)
Day groups stick while the virtual list scrolls
The composer opens inline, as panel, window or page; the choice persists and a draft survives closing it (tests)
At 390 px list and reader are separate panes and the composer is a bottom sheet
The mail page shows the frames with no design-reviewer P1
out_of_scope: A mail transport, threading by headers, rich text. Chat messages as a channel view (the chat parts row covers messages). A snooze or rules engine.
